title: Prototype-trace interface contract
summary: A prototype-trace run MUST produce skeletons, trace tests including one end-to-end path, and a machine-readable interface schema at a declared path. That schema is the reference contract. The operator MUST approve it before later standard or decomposition work starts from it.
instructions: A prototype-trace run exists to freeze new interfaces before later implementation. The trace stage MUST produce skeleton definitions for every new function and endpoint: signatures, expected input and output shapes, and docstrings or usage specs. Stub bodies MUST return shape-valid data or fail explicitly as not implemented.
The trace stage MUST produce trace tests at each new boundary, using test data. The trace tests MUST include at least one end-to-end or integration path through every layer the task touches.

Every declared skeleton and trace test path MUST resolve to a nonempty regular file inside the run workspace. The harness MUST run each declared trace test file through the configured trace repository-check profile before approval. A missing runner, failed or unexecuted test, or changed artifact MUST block approval. The trace profile receives PANCREATOR_TRACE_TEST_FILE as a workspace-relative path; the target must configure a documented runner that fails when no tests are collected. A static or unrelated suite pass MUST NOT substitute for trace execution.

The trace stage MUST write an interface schema: a machine-readable contract in the target stack's idiom, plus short usage notes. The schema MUST live in the target repository at the path declared in data.interface_schema.path, and it MUST be versioned with the code.

The interface schema is the reference contract for every later implementation. A later change to an interface in the schema MUST update the schema in the same change. Verification MUST report drift between claimed signatures and the schema.
The operator MUST approve the interface schema at the trace stage gate before any standard or decomposition work starts from it.

The prototype spike workflow MUST stay unchanged. TRACE-001 binds only prototype-trace. The JSON manifest MUST map named signatures to actual source declarations and a native contract path; later verification MUST check the current manifest and source.
Before submission, prototype-trace stage outputs MUST run their resolved policy-bound validators under VALID-001.
